channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Day'Ron Sharpe | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Day'Ron Sharpe from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Day'Ron Sharpe
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on Day'Ron Sharpe:

“We could see him at some point this week. Right now he's going through the process of going through contact drills, then see how he feels after that and take the next step. So, that's as much as I can tell you.”

Jordi Fernandez on Day'Ron Sharpe, Dec 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Day'Ron Sharpe
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Day'Ron Sharpe's recovery:

“He's really limited on the court right now: shooting free-throws, dribbling the basketball, no other players around him. No setbacks though... He said he had been feeling the best since the injury, which was good to hear.”

Jacque Vaughn on Day'Ron Sharpe, Jan 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Day'Ron Sharpe
item.description:
Ajayi Browne:Jordan Ott says,

“Day’Ron (Sharpe) was a monster— He’s such a big part of what we’re doing.”

Jordan Ott on Day'Ron Sharpe, Aug 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @ajayibrowne.
